details: It was working 4 days ago, I uploaded a new Personal Rexoium with a new texture Idea I had in mind. Then I came back the next day due to the vismes not working and the sdk broke. And I removed it from the project through file explorer like the documentation on the VRC website says to do but everytime I re-imported the sdk the vrc tab at the top of unity did not appear. So I made a brand new project and the same thing happened so downloaded the sdk again from the website in case mine was corrupted but still no avail. So I checked all of my of my other projects and their sdk's all broke as well. And now I can no longer upload models for the time being. Any help would be appreciated!
title: Sdk2 2020.07.15.38 broke on all of my Unity projects
